references.label: Top saucers
references.description: The two upper saucers that advance value and start Pac-Maze when enough moves are stored.

references.label: Upper-right skill-shot lane
references.description: The precise plunge lane into the top-right saucer for ten moves and Pac-Man Aggressive.

references.label: Upper three-target bank
references.description: The upper-flipper bank that adds moves and can open the left-outlane gate.

references.label: Lower four-target banks
references.description: The dangerous lower banks that add five moves when completed.

references.label: P-A-C-M-A-N standups
references.description: The six lit standups that add moves and restore a life when the word is completed.

references.label: Pac-Maze grid
references.description: The 25-light grid controlled by the flipper buttons while the physical ball is held.

references.label: Center maze space
references.description: The grid's center space, which the ghost cannot enter.

references.label: Left-outlane gate
references.description: The gate opened by repeated upper-bank completions.

references.label: Upper flipper
references.description: The flipper used for upper-bank and saucer control after a full plunge.
